range_decision.evidence: A temporary observation offset is identified in two consecutive intervals. The first interval (indices 602-630) shows an abrupt positive step across all three components (N, E, U). This state is sustained for approximately one month before being terminated by a second abrupt shift at index 631. The second interval (indices 631-658) represents the continuation of this anomaly, where the displacement levels are shifted even further (E and U jump to higher values, N drops significantly). This extreme offset persists until index 659, where an opposing return brings the trajectory back towards the baseline level established prior to index 602.
